parsed.critic: High tree disagreement (10-15 MPa) plus multi-ingredient changes mean C01 and C06 confound fly ash and slag effects with binder content, and C14's zero superplasticizer at 0.28 water-to-binder risks a stiff, poorly consolidated mix despite high cement.
parsed.selection_rationale: Top predictions cluster at water-to-binder 0.27-0.30 with binder 420-530 kg/m3, matching the high-cement/low-water winners, so testing C01 and C02 first captures likely upside while C06, C04 and C14 probe binder-type and admixture effects at similar ratios.

decision.critic: High tree disagreement (10-15 MPa) plus multi-ingredient changes mean C01 and C06 confound fly ash and slag effects with binder content, and C14's zero superplasticizer at 0.28 water-to-binder risks a stiff, poorly consolidated mix despite high cement.
